name: 呂怜樺
objective:
Course Statement
This course offers an overview of traditional management, its philosophy and role in society, and knowledge of models for analyzing and controlling the management function in the organization. It covers basic concepts and offers case studies from industrial practice.
課程進度(1-16週):
Week and Date          Topics
W1             Class Introduction 
W2             Introduction to Management
W3             Why we need management
W4             No class
W5             Decision Making
W6             Global Management
W7             Valuing a Diverse Workforce
W8             No class
W9             Mid-term Exam
W10            No class  
W11            Planning and Goal Setting
W12            Group Activity 
W13            Group Activity 
W14            Strategic Planning 
W15            Organization Design 
W16            Final Exam
彈性學習(17-18週):
類別
		  
		    ● 學生分組實作及討論 (Student group practice and discussion)
● 遠距教學 (Distance learning)
		  
      

      
        內容
        
          W17: 期末課程報告
Week18: 課程報告與期末反思
        
      

      
        時數 (小時)
        
          6
        
      

      
        學習成果
        
          繳交報告以及期末考之後, 學生應能對於管理學以及產業動態有初步了解
